verdict.rationale: monday.com ships agents and app-building tools (an agent framework, monday vibe, and a developer MCP for scaffolding), so self-verification of built apps is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows an agent navigating a UI or capturing before-and-after screenshots to verify its work. The cited agent, MCP and sandbox features cover execution, hosting and access control, not visual verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
